statement.notes: All amounts are in millions. For 'operating_expenses', mapped from 'Total costs and expenses' line. For 'interest_expenses', mapped from 'Automotive interest expense' line (excludes GM Financial interest expenses which are included in operating expenses). 'Net income' mapped from 'Net income (loss)' line (before attribution to noncontrolling interests and common stockholders), as this represents the consolidated net income for the period. 'Revenue' mapped from 'Total net sales and revenue'.
